title: Grilled Hake Tacos
description: A flavorful Mexican dish featuring grilled hake, topped with a mix of spices and served with a side of crispy tortillas.

ingredients.name: Adventurous Spices
ingredients.notes: A mix of cumin, chili powder, and smoked paprika

ingredients.name: Silky Avocado Salsa
ingredients.notes: Diced avocado, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and lime juice

instructions: Season hake fillets with adventurous spices, salt, and pepper.
Grill hake for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing grilled hake on a tortilla, topped with silky avocado salsa, Russian rye bread crumbs, and a squeeze of lime juice.
